law_record.title: Certain vehicles required to stop at all railroad grade (3)
law_record.text: When stopping is required at a railroad crossing the driver shall keep as far to the right of the highway as possible and shall not form two lanes of traffic unless the highway is marked for four or more lanes of traffic.

activation_conditions: a stop is required at a railroad crossing
the highway is not marked for four or more lanes of traffic
exceptions: where the highway is marked for four or more lanes of traffic
